parameters.subject: Saturday ritual: pantry + cart before tomorrow's order
parameters.text:
Tomorrow at 8am the weekly Kroger order auto-runs. Do this now (5 minutes):

1. Tandoor: mark foods you actually have as 'on hand' in the pantry (Settings -> Foods or the recipe view)
2. Tandoor: confirm next week's meal plan is set (Mon-Sun)
3. Kroger app: clear the cart from last week

Then tomorrow morning n8n builds the delivery list from the plan + pantry and fills the Kroger cart. You still review before checkout.
